positions.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Systems
positions.description: Worked for the Autonomy and Mapping team. Projects included: improving auto-generated sensor analysis reports, quantifying the quality of point clouds, and enhancing the health monitor system.

positions.title: Intern, Robotics Engineering
positions.description: Developed an automatically generated analysis of the quality of sensor information for quadrotors.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Research Assistant under Dr. Mark Campbell. Utilized Natural Language Processing techniques to spread information between humans and robots for applications in search and rescue scenarios.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for MAE5180: Autonomous Mobile Robots under Dr. Hadas Kress-Gazit. This course teaches the fundamentals of sensing, navigating, and mapping an environment autonomously. Held office hours, led lab periods, and graded homework.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for ENGR105: Introduction to Scientific Computing under the following professors: Prof. Nikolaos Aravas (2015, Spring), Dr. Camillo Jose Taylor (2016-17, Spring), Dr. Graham Wabiszewski (2016-17, Fall) and Dr. Bruce Kothman (2018, Spring). Led laboratory periods, graded homework, and held office hours to teach the foundations of the programming language MATLAB.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research Assistant under Dr. Vijay Kumar. Developed code to allow groups of quadrotors to update their formation to prevent collision with both each other as well as surrounding obstacles.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research Assistant under Dr. Katherine Kuchenbecker. Collected and analyzed texture data in order to relate sensor information with visual input.

volunteerExperiences.description: Odyssey is a summer enrichment program designed to give its students a head start on the upcoming school year.
